description:
+Chatter Expansion Project+
Adds 65 iconic characters from all over media and history (with many more to come!) for the Combat Chatter mod.

Name your officers in the following ways to ensure their personalities:

Spoiler
Master of Darkness Aku (Samurai Jack)
Albert Wesker (Resident Evil)
Arcturus Mengsk (Starcraft)
Ben Kenobi (Star Wars)
Big Smoke (Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas)
Captain Roosevelt (Hunt Down the Freeman)
Chef Slowik (The Menu)
Crazy Campbell (Metal Gear Solid 2:Sons of Liberty)
Dagoth Ur (TES3:Morrowind)
Boss Diavolo (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)
Dio Brando (JoJo)
Doctor Breen (HL2)
Doctor Zoidberg (Futurama)
Sheev Palpatine (Star Wars)
Kent Mansley (Iron Giant)
King Eredin (The Witcher 3)
Enrico Pucci (JoJo)
Frank Horrigan (Fallout 2)
G-Man *OR* G Man (Half-Life)
Hot Coldman (MGSPW)
Huey Emmerich (MGSPW&V)
Jacob Keyes (Halo) written by Phoebe Core (Vuski) (thanks for the contribution!)
JC Denton (Deus Ex)
Jeanne d'Arc Alter (Fate Grand Order) written by WENth100 (thanks for the contribution!)
John Henry Eden (Fallout 3)
John Homelander (The Boys)
HK-47 (Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic)
Legate Lanius (Fallout: New Vegas)
Marv (Sin City)
Monsoon (Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance)
Morvran Voorhis (The Witcher 3)
Nute Gunray (Star Wars)
Oberyn Martell (A Song of Ice and Fire)
Oogie Mango (Rogue Tower)
Valery Legasov (Chernobyl TV series)
Richard B. Riddick (Riddick)
Red Prince (Divinity: Original Sin 2)
Alex Murphy (Robocop)
Rogal Dorn (Warhammer 30k)
Roy Batty (Blade Runner)
Sarevok Anchev (Baldur's Gate)
Scaramouche the Merciless (Samurai Jack)
Soldier Boy (The Boys)
Solidus Snake (Metal Gear Solid 2:Sons of Liberty)
Steven Armstrong (Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance)
Sun Tzu (Historical figure who wrote 'The Art of War') written by Phoebe Core (Vuski) (thanks for the contribution!)
Tyber Zann (Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption)
Tiberius Rancor (Fallout: The Frontier)
Todd Howard (Bethesda Softworks)
Yes Man (Fallout: New Vegas)
William Butcher (The Boys)
William Foster (Falling Down)
Zapp Brannigan (Futurama)
Jean-Baptiste Zorg (Fifth Element)

Please note that these are not all the new characters added to the mod.

All the characters are owned by their respective owners unless otherwise stated.

It is safe to add to saves and update on the same save (save-compatible).
Requires LazyLib, MagicLib, Combat Chatter
Special thanks to Histidine for the help and permission to make this long-time dream of mine a reality!
Changelog:

Spoiler
1.2.0
Added:
+ added 11 new characters!
1.1.0
Added:
+ added 9 new characters!
+ upgraded 2!
1.0.0
Added:
+ added 45 new characters!
